title: Curse Of Scully MMO optimization (solved)
author: Wide_Holiday_8411
selftext:
So, Curse Of Scully has been in development fot 8 months now. A lot of work and new content...but as maps grow and systems grow optimization and architecture needs to be clear.

I have made about 3-5 posts hear over teh course of half a year. Mostly to update how I got something fixed and how. Today is no different.

Suddenly,  after expanding the map for Ocean Tycoon  part of the game (almost 10x) we needed to fill it out with quests,  islands, bountys etc. But...the game started stuttering...and it wasn't on high graphics settings only. 

Sometimes high settings ran better than medium. So i delved into shaders, shadows, masks for the islands. I also tried day and night settings, weather issues, rain thunder. Inconsistent results.

I moverd everything to close render system 4000px around the ship....still issues. Intried loading islands into ram once...still. 

Finally I discovered the field of ice stacks scenes.

So ice-field had independent moving code. I wanted them to drift.

Big mistake, as that had to calculate every movement and stack them. This caused about 60% extra usage of memory. Also created about 1200 grabage renders in 1 minute. Frame rate driopped forom 59 to 18.

After optimizing we managed to clear it all. Constant 60fps...with the lowest of 38, once in 5 minutes I battle.

Happy days!
